gaps.name: Understanding of Automated Monitoring Systems
gaps.description: Ability to interpret, synthesize, and explain system-generated alerts, dashboards, and embedded benchmarks as the basis for recommending operational improvements.

gaps.justification: Moving from periodic review to ongoing, iterative updates and interventions in response to real-time evidence requires confidence in managing digital workflows.
gaps.name: Workflow Integration and Digital Update
gaps.description: Skill in actioning recommendations within digital systems, tracking interventions, and updating standardized logs rather than producing separate, static reports.

affected work-description elements.element: Key Activities - 'Provides feedback on collection, processing, editing, compilation and presentation methods and procedures following data analysis and makes recommendations for improvements to established survey methods and activities.'
affected work-description elements.element update reasoning: Feedback is now expected to be delivered rapidly in response to system-generated evidence and to be actioned via standardized, logged recommendations rather than bespoke narrative advice.

gaps.justification: Recommendations are increasingly codified, requiring competence in the logic of event triggers, benchmarks, and digital feedback forms.
gaps.name: Dashboard-Based Feedback and Recommendation Logging
gaps.description: Ability to utilize dashboards for targeted recommendations, use standardized templates, and update process logs for traceability.

affected work-description elements.element: Key Activities - 'Writes and presents study results and recommendations, often as detailed reports following manual investigation and post-hoc review.'
affected work-description elements.element update reasoning: Shift from narrative report generation toward integrating findings directly into dashboards and digital update systems, with less emphasis on document-based communication.

gaps.justification: Legacy reporting communication skills must be complemented by facility with digital presentation tools and dashboard communication.
gaps.name: Digital Dashboard Communication
gaps.description: Ability to communicate interventions, rationale, and outcomes clearly using digital dashboards, standardized templates, and automated tracking systems.

affected work-description elements.element: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities or Efforts - 'Decision Making: Interprets preliminary results, reviews study format and modifies approaches and techniques as necessary.'
affected work-description elements.element update reasoning: Analysis and modification are driven by system-generated evidence, necessitating the capacity to judge when automated alerts require human intervention versus passive monitoring.

gaps.justification: Decision-making must integrate both subject-matter authority and interpretation of automated metrics.
gaps.name: Dashboard Thresholds and Event Logic
gaps.description: Understanding how and when dashboard-generated performance flags require intervention, escalation, or adjustment.

affected work-description elements.element: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities or Efforts - 'Leadership and Operational Management: Leads project teams involved in the conduct of subject matter studies/reviews.'
affected work-description elements.element update reasoning: Leadership now demands cross-functional collaboration for rapid response to system-generated issues, using shared, codified data evidence as decision support.

gaps.justification: Collaborative tools and digital evidence replace ad-hoc coordination; leaders must facilitate fast, data-driven decision-making.
gaps.name: Facilitation of Digital, Evidence-Based Decision Making
gaps.description: Skill in coordinating teams to act on real-time quality or process alerts, using shared dashboards and rapid communication channels.

affected work-description elements.element: Technical Activities, Skills, Responsibilities or Efforts - 'Research and Analysis: Interprets study results... reviews and resolves gaps and inconsistencies... reviews the conceptual framework used and compatibility with other statistical programs.'
affected work-description elements.element update reasoning: The detection of methodological and operational gaps becomes semi-automated; review functions require verifying and contextualizing digital gap and inconsistency alerts.

gaps.justification: Traditional, manual investigation must be complemented by facility with jointly analyzing system-discovered and human-noticed issues.
gaps.name: Interpretation of System-Generated Analytical Evidence
gaps.description: Knowledge of how to work with, validate, and provide context for automated findings, and to escalate or dismiss based on holistic evidence.
